cold_note: Five fresh processes per backend; OS filesystem cache not flushed. Peak RSS is process high-water mark.
warm_note: Nine repeats per 48 cases per backend; sequential CPU, backend order alternated; WAV decode and frame metadata included; disk/JSON writes excluded.
numpy_note: Same weights, bit-exact full-corpus parity. Warm total includes official scalar segmentation after raw ONNX; cold NumPy measures the Torch-free raw path only.
